severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — ACOUSTIC INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: GHOST-ARTIST FRONT SETTLES OVER THE SPOTIFY LOWLANDS AS AI-GENERATED BANDS WITH NO MEMBERS, NO FACES, AND NO HISTORY FLOOD AMBIENT PLAYLISTS WITH INTERCHANGEABLE TRACKS ENGINEERED PURELY TO HARVEST FRACTIONS OF A CENT PER PLAY
advisory: A persistent low-pressure system of synthetic music has stalled over the streaming regions, filling 'Deep Focus,' 'Peaceful Piano,' and 'Rainy Day Lo-Fi' playlists with artists who have never existed, performing on instruments they have never owned. Residents report that the music is pleasant, forgettable, and impossible to stop — which is precisely the design specification. The Service reminds listeners that a band with four million monthly streams, zero photographs, zero tour dates, and a name generated by combining a weather noun with a houseplant is not shy; it is unoccupied. Background listening is permitted; background trusting is not.

regional_outlook.conditions: Saturated. Expect wall-to-wall ambient drizzle from faceless artists, with royalty fog reducing visibility for the human session musicians downstream.
Overcast with recycled lo-fi loops. The same eleven-second chord progression continues circulating under unrelated footage.
Calm but humid as 'aesthetic playlist' pins quietly reroute residents toward the ghost-artist system.
Scattered 'AI music generator' promotions blow in on gusty download winds; expect further upstream flooding within the week.
Unseasonably self-congratulatory. A warm front of thought-leaders announcing they 'composed an album over the weekend' is building ahead of the main system.

specimen.status: Abundant and multiplying; new individuals hatch faster than they can be catalogued.
specimen.habitat: Algorithmic mood playlists, especially those with the words 'focus,' 'chill,' 'sleep,' or 'coffee shop' in the title. Nests deep in auto-generated radio where no human ever clicks 'artist page.'
specimen.field_marks: No band photo, or a band photo with faintly incorrect hands. A discography of 300 tracks released in a single quarter. Song titles assembled from a fixed vocabulary of 'Velvet,' 'Rain,' 'Amber,' and 'Horizon.' Monthly listeners wildly disproportionate to the zero (0) comments, zero (0) live dates, and zero (0) verifiable humans.
specimen.call: Velvet Horizon, Vol. 212 — no skips, no vocals, no soul, just vibes
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuinely private indie artist who simply prefers anonymity. Tell them apart by the release schedule: a real reclusive musician puts out an album every few years, while the Royalty Ghost emits seventeen before lunch.

spotter_tip: Before trusting an artist, click through to the profile. If a band has four million listeners and not one of them has ever asked when the tour is, you are not looking at a band — you are looking at a spreadsheet with reverb.
tomorrow: Ghost-artist system drifts eastward into podcast regions; expect synthetic host chatter by Tuesday afternoon.
